Receipts cover independent ZIP extraction, tests and every fixed input within each group. Changes of settings, methods or step sizes do not add independent physical problems. Rotated diffusion: full-tensor Q1, MG and AMG Retain nonzero Kxy in the Q1 weak form and compare analytic refinement with MG/AMG convergence for the same matrix. Assumptions, units and boundaries Unit square, zero Dirichlet, K=R(pi/6)diag(1,.01)R^T, exact sin(pi x)sin(pi y), N16/32/64. Editorial clarification One angle/anisotropy only. Scalar TPFA is not extended to rotated tensors; arbitrary-tensor robustness is not established. Adopted numerical method Full2x2 tensor Q1 and Gauss quadrature.
